title: Sports Criminological and Psychological Analysis of Boundary Violations for the Purpose of Addressing the Issue in Gymnastics
summary:
Since early 2025, reports of physical, psychological, and sexual violence in competitive gymnastics in Germany have garnered significant attention. Despite growing discussion, the current state of research regarding the prevalence of violence—including its structural causes and psychosocial consequences—still has gaps.

The study therefore aims to investigate under what circumstances and what experiences of violence gymnasts have encountered in the sport of gymnastics, what psychological effects these experiences have on the gymnasts, and how the process of coming to terms with these incidents, as well as their portrayal in the media, is perceived and evaluated.

The survey will initially be conducted using quantitative survey data, which will then be statistically analyzed and processed.
conditions: ICD-10 and general symptoms. Diagnosis based on voluntary self-report.
Reaction to severe stress, and adjustment disorders
Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of sedatives or hypnotics

interventions.name:
A non-interventional, one-time observational study

Current and former gymnasts will be surveyed once via an online questionnaire. Each session lasts about 45 minutes. The questionnaire includes items developed specifically for this study, as well as the World Health Organization-Five Well-Being I

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Current and former competitive gymnasts in Germany in the disciplines of artistic gymnastics, trampoline gymnastics, and rhythmic gymnastics
Exclusion criteria:
Age groups under 16
